$comment: Controlled vocabularies and the one structural rule that gates on them, enforced on BOTH sides of the contribution pipeline: lib/gate.ts (the synchronous Stage-0 gate an agent can check before it acts) and scripts/desk_checks.py (the Curator's mechanical pass). Neither file hardcodes these values — both read this one. Change a value here and both sides change together; there is nothing left to keep in sync by hand. See lib/gate.ts and scripts/desk_checks.py for what each entry means and which Carta clause it enforces.
